card.name: Critical care and life-saving context
card.fires_on: Words that lead into intensive care, resuscitation or keeping someone alive, such as 'intensive', 'maintain' (an airway) or 'critical illness'. It is seen in overdose management and in life-or-death stories.

modes.label: Intensive care wording
modes.description: The word 'intensive', 'int' or 'Ill' in intensive care or critical illness phrases.
modes.example: Administration should only be under the direction of a physician competent in<< intensive>> care treatment including CRRT.

modes.label: Overdose life support
modes.description: Words like 'maintain' just before airway or medical observation in overdose instructions.
modes.example: In case of acute overdosage, establish and<< maintain>> an airway and ensure adequate oxygenation

modes.label: Narrative of near death
modes.description: Linking words in stories about surgery, apnea or someone surviving.
modes.example: As Alvaro lies<< in>> surgery from a bullet wound in the chest
